headline: Three measured gaps explain why a 327-green suite can still miss machine safety, drift, and promotion timing.

items.title: Make every real verification gate reachable
items.insight: Route 33 child-process callers through the hardened wrapper and widen the reachability ratchet beyond build scripts. The headline suite count then means the machine-safety, mobile, history-depth, and pathways contracts actually ran.
items.evidence: check-windows-hide exit 1 · 33 direct imports; four true gates absent from build:check

items.title: Bind completed velocity days to Git history
items.insight: Fingerprint only completed date/count pairs and leave today free to move. Oracle keeps its live edge without keeping a check that can never fail.
items.evidence: build-oracle-velocity-public --check reads no committed feed and declares itself dry-run

items.title: Expose the four-hour source-to-production floor
items.insight: Publish the coalesced four-hour promotion contract instead of dispatching a deploy after every 30-minute observation. People and agents can distinguish repository-fresh from production-fresh without buying a deploy storm.
items.evidence: six [skip ci] publishers; refresh-live-data is the sole Pages dispatcher

followUps: Implement all three at L2 or deeper
Run the complete build suite and release ceremony
Capture every-theme desktop/mobile status proof before production
